name: record-status
description: Shows the status written inside a Markdown file (tasks, decisions, specs, ADRs) as the file's icon, name colour and folder progress in the Explorer. File names never change.

recordStatus.profiles.markdownDescription: Kinds of record, in order: the first profile whose `include` globs match a file owns it. Each profile has `include` (globs relative to the workspace folder), an optional `statusPattern`, and `statuses` (word → look). Empty uses the built-in profiles: `task` (`**/tasks/*.md`), `decision` (`**/decisions/*.md`), `spec` (`**/spec/*.md`) and `reference` (`**/assessments/*.md`).

include.description: Globs, relative to the workspace folder, of this kind's files.

statusPattern.description: Regular expression that finds the status; the first group is it. Defaults to recordStatus.statusPattern.

icon.description: Material Icon Theme icon name, e.g. "todo", "verified", "key". Empty keeps the file's icon.

iconColor.description: Material palette colour ("amber-500", "gray-500", …) or a hex colour.

nameColor.description: Theme colour id for the file name, e.g. "recordStatus.completed". Empty leaves the name alone.

badge.description: Up to two characters always shown after the name.

glyph.description: Up to two characters shown after the name when icons are not available (badge mode).

rollup.description: For folder roll-up: "done" counts as done, "skip" is not counted.

recordStatus.statusPattern.description: Default regular expression that finds the status inside a file. The first capture group is the status. It is lower-cased, and anything from " by " on is dropped.

enumDescriptions: Bundled when Record Status Icons is the active file icon theme, Material when Material Icon Theme is, otherwise badges.
Use this extension's icon theme, Record Status Icons. Writes nothing into the workspace. Falls back to badges while another icon theme is active.
Material Icon Theme clones, written into the workspace settings (material-icon-theme.files.customClones).
No icon change: a coloured glyph after the file name.
recordStatus.iconMode.description: How a record's status reaches its Explorer icon.

recordStatus.rollup.markdownDescription: Folder progress badges: the percentage of records that are done, `✓` at 100%. `enabled` (default true), `profiles` (whose records count; default `["task"]`), `folders` (globs of folders that get a badge; empty means the folder above each record's folder, e.g. `SavesV2` for `SavesV2/tasks/*.md`), `nameColor` (folder name colour at 100%; default `recordStatus.completed`).

recordStatus.include.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `recordStatus.profiles`. Still read, as one profile, when `profiles` is empty.
recordStatus.include.description: 0.2: globs of the files whose status is shown.

recordStatus.statuses.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `recordStatus.profiles`. Still read, as one profile, when `profiles` is empty.

recordStatus.icons.description: 0.2: replace the file icon with the status icon.
